 Benfica ‘monitoring’ Tony Strata with Sporting and Braga also linked 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Digisport reports that Benfica are monitoring Vitória de Guimarães right back Tony Strata , with Sporting and Braga also cited as potential suitors.
 The club could seek a defensive reinforcement, and competition may complicate any move.
 OneFootball Videos
 The leading domestic sides are following the defender’s progress with the Minho outfit. However, Vitória de Guimarães have not received any concrete offers, so no deal is in place.
 The Guimarães hierarchy would be open to a sale if a financially attractive proposal arrives. A transfer remains possible, but any advance would depend on terms and the club’s stance on the player’s future.
 Strata joined Vitória de Guimarães in the summer of 2025 after leaving Ajaccio in France.
 The Romania international has two senior caps and has made 10 appearances this season, supplying one assist.
